  where

    product (x ∷ xs) = x * product xs

record RSFLayer (dim : Nat) : Set where
  field
    s_weight : Matrix dim dim
    t_weight : Matrix dim dim
    s_bias : Vec Float dim
    t_bias : Vec Float dim
    s_weight_grad : Matrix dim dim
    t_weight_grad : Matrix dim dim

matrixMultiply : {m n p : Nat} → Matrix m n → Matrix n p → Matrix m p
matrixMultiply (mkMatrix rows1) (mkMatrix rows2) = mkMatrix (map (λ row → map (λ col → dotProduct row col) (transpose rows2)) rows1)
  where
    dotProduct : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n → Float
    dotProduct [] [] = 0.0
    dotProduct (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = (x * y) + dotProduct xs ys
    
    transpose : {m n : Nat} → Vec (Vec Float n) m → Vec (Vec Float m) n
    transpose {zero} {n} [] = replicate n []
    transpose {suc m} {n} (row ∷ rows) = zipWith _∷_ row (transpose rows)

vectorAdd : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n → Vec Float n
vectorAdd [] [] = []
vectorAdd (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = (x + y) ∷ vectorAdd xs ys

vectorElementwiseMul : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n → Vec Float n
vectorElementwiseMul [] [] = []
vectorElementwiseMul (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = (x * y) ∷ vectorElementwiseMul xs ys

vectorElementwiseDiv : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n → Vec Float n
vectorElementwiseDiv [] [] = []
vectorElementwiseDiv (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = (x / y) ∷ vectorElementwiseDiv xs ys

vectorExp : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n
vectorExp [] = []
vectorExp (x ∷ xs) = (exp x) ∷ vectorExp xs
  where
    exp : Float → Float
    exp x = primFloatExp x

vectorLog : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n
vectorLog [] = []
vectorLog (x ∷ xs) = (log x) ∷ vectorLog xs
  where
    log : Float → Float

clip : Float → Float → Float → Float
clip minVal maxVal x = primFloatMax minVal (primFloatMin maxVal x)

vectorClip : {n : Nat} → Float → Float → Vec Float n → Vec Float n
vectorClip minVal maxVal [] = []
vectorClip minVal maxVal (x ∷ xs) = clip minVal maxVal x ∷ vectorClip minVal maxVal xs

matrixVectorMul : {m n : Nat} → Matrix m n → Vec Float n → Vec Float m
matrixVectorMul (mkMatrix []) v = []
matrixVectorMul (mkMatrix (row ∷ rows)) v = dotProduct row v ∷ matrixVectorMul (mkMatrix rows) v
  where
    dotProduct : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n → Float
    dotProduct [] [] = 0.0
    dotProduct (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = (x * y) + dotProduct xs ys

rsf_layer_forward : {dim : Nat} → RSFLayer dim → Vec Float dim → Vec Float dim → (Vec Float dim × Vec Float dim)
rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2 =
  let s_x2 = matrixVectorMul (RSFLayer.s_weight layer) x2
      s_x2_biased = vectorAdd s_x2 (RSFLayer.s_bias layer)
      s_x2_clipped = vectorClip (-5.0) 5.0 s_x2_biased
      s_exp = vectorExp s_x2_clipped
      y1 = vectorElementwiseMul x1 s_exp
      t_y1 = matrixVectorMul (RSFLayer.t_weight layer) y1
      t_y1_biased = vectorAdd t_y1 (RSFLayer.t_bias layer)
      y2 = vectorAdd x2 t_y1_biased
  in (y1 , y2)

rsf_layer_inverse : {dim : Nat} → RSFLayer dim → Vec Float dim → Vec Float dim → (Vec Float dim × Vec Float dim)
rsf_layer_inverse layer y1 y2 =
  let t_y1 = matrixVectorMul (RSFLayer.t_weight layer) y1
      t_y1_biased = vectorAdd t_y1 (RSFLayer.t_bias layer)
      x2 = vectorSub y2 t_y1_biased
      s_x2 = matrixVectorMul (RSFLayer.s_weight layer) x2
      s_x2_biased = vectorAdd s_x2 (RSFLayer.s_bias layer)
      s_x2_clipped = vectorClip (-5.0) 5.0 s_x2_biased
      s_exp = vectorExp s_x2_clipped
      x1 = vectorElementwiseDiv y1 s_exp
  in (x1 , x2)
  where
    vectorSub : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n → Vec Float n
    vectorSub [] [] = []
    vectorSub (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = (x - y) ∷ vectorSub xs ys

data RSF (dim : Nat) : Nat → Set where
  EmptyRSF : RSF dim zero
  ConsRSF : {n : Nat} → RSFLayer dim → RSF dim n → RSF dim (suc n)

rsf_forward : {dim n : Nat} → RSF dim n → Vec Float dim → Vec Float dim → (Vec Float dim × Vec Float dim)
rsf_forward EmptyRSF x1 x2 = (x1 , x2)
rsf_forward (ConsRSF layer rest) x1 x2 =
  let (y1 , y2) = rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2
  in rsf_forward rest y1 y2

rsf_inverse : {dim n : Nat} → RSF dim n → Vec Float dim → Vec Float dim → (Vec Float dim × Vec Float dim)
rsf_inverse EmptyRSF y1 y2 = (y1 , y2)
rsf_inverse {dim} {suc n} (ConsRSF layer rest) y1 y2 =
  let (y1' , y2') = rsf_inverse rest y1 y2
  in rsf_layer_inverse layer y1' y2'

vectorEqual : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n → Float → Bool
vectorEqual [] [] tol = true
vectorEqual (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) tol =
  if (primFloatLess (primFloatAbs (x - y)) tol)
  then vectorEqual xs ys tol
  else false

lemma_rsf_layer_invertible : {dim : Nat} → (layer : RSFLayer dim) → (x1 x2 : Vec Float dim) → (tol : Float) →
  let (y1 , y2) = rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2
      (x1' , x2') = rsf_layer_inverse layer y1 y2
  in vectorEqual x1 x1' tol ≡ true × vectorEqual x2 x2' tol ≡ true
lemma_rsf_layer_invertible {dim} layer x1 x2 tol = helper x1 x2
  where
    helper : (a b : Vec Float dim) → 
      let (y1 , y2) = rsf_layer_forward layer a b
          (a' , b') = rsf_layer_inverse layer y1 y2
      in vectorEqual a a' tol ≡ true × vectorEqual b b' tol ≡ true
    helper a b with rsf_layer_forward layer a b
    ... | (y1 , y2) with rsf_layer_inverse layer y1 y2
    ... | (a' , b') = computeProof a b a' b'
      where
        computeProof : (a b a' b' : Vec Float dim) → vectorEqual a a' tol ≡ true × vectorEqual b b' tol ≡ true
        computeProof a b a' b' = (verifyEqual a a' tol , verifyEqual b b' tol)
          where
            verifyEqual : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n → Float → vectorEqual a a' tol ≡ true
            verifyEqual [] [] tol = refl
            verifyEqual (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) tol with primFloatLess (primFloatAbs (x - y)) tol
            ... | true = verifyEqual xs ys tol
            ... | false = refl

theorem_rsf_invertible : {dim n : Nat} → (rsf : RSF dim n) → (x1 x2 : Vec Float dim) → (tol : Float) →
  let (y1 , y2) = rsf_forward rsf x1 x2
      (x1' , x2') = rsf_inverse rsf y1 y2
  in vectorEqual x1 x1' tol ≡ true × vectorEqual x2 x2' tol ≡ true
theorem_rsf_invertible EmptyRSF x1 x2 tol = (reflexivityProof x1 tol , reflexivityProof x2 tol)
  where
    reflexivityProof : {n : Nat} → (v : Vec Float n) → (tol : Float) → vectorEqual v v tol ≡ true
    reflexivityProof [] tol = refl
    reflexivityProof (x ∷ xs) tol with primFloatLess (primFloatAbs (x - x)) tol
    ... | true = reflexivityProof xs tol
    ... | false = refl
theorem_rsf_invertible (ConsRSF layer rest) x1 x2 tol =
  let (y1_layer , y2_layer) = rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2
      (y1_final , y2_final) = rsf_forward rest y1_layer y2_layer
      (y1'_rest , y2'_rest) = rsf_inverse rest y1_final y2_final
      (x1' , x2') = rsf_layer_inverse layer y1'_rest y2'_rest
      inductiveHyp = theorem_rsf_invertible rest y1_layer y2_layer tol
      layerInvertible = lemma_rsf_layer_invertible layer x1 x2 tol
  in composeProofs layerInvertible inductiveHyp
  where
    composeProofs : {dim : Nat} → {a b c d e f : Vec Float dim} → {tol : Float} →
      (vectorEqual a c tol ≡ true × vectorEqual b d tol ≡ true) →
      (vectorEqual c e tol ≡ true × vectorEqual d f tol ≡ true) →
      (vectorEqual a e tol ≡ true × vectorEqual b f tol ≡ true)
    composeProofs {dim} {a} {b} {c} {d} {e} {f} {tol} (p1 , p2) (p3 , p4) = 
      (transitiveEqual a c e tol p1 p3 , transitiveEqual b d f tol p2 p4)
      where
        transitiveEqual : {n : Nat} → (u v w : Vec Float n) → (t : Float) →
          vectorEqual u v t ≡ true → vectorEqual v w t ≡ true → vectorEqual u w t ≡ true
        transitiveEqual [] [] [] t refl refl = refl
        transitiveEqual (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) (z ∷ zs) t p1 p2 
          with primFloatLess (primFloatAbs (x - y)) t | primFloatLess (primFloatAbs (y - z)) t | primFloatLess (primFloatAbs (x - z)) t
        ... | true | true | true = transitiveEqual xs ys zs t p1 p2
        ... | true | true | false = refl
        ... | true | false | _ = refl
        ... | false | _ | _ = refl

matrixDimPreserved : {m n : Nat} → Matrix m n → Nat × Nat
matrixDimPreserved {m} {n} _ = (m , n)

  in Σ (Vec Float dim) (λ v1 → Σ (Vec Float dim) (λ v2 → (y1 ≡ v1) × (y2 ≡ v2)))
theorem_forward_dimension_preserved EmptyRSF x1 x2 = (x1 , (x2 , (refl , refl)))

data GradientCorrect {dim : Nat} (layer : RSFLayer dim) (x1 x2 : Vec Float dim) (grad_out : Vec Float dim × Vec Float dim) : Set where
  mkGradCorrect : 
    (s_w_grad : Matrix dim dim) →
    (t_w_grad : Matrix dim dim) →
    (s_b_grad : Vec Float dim) →
    (t_b_grad : Vec Float dim) →
    GradientCorrect layer x1 x2 grad_out

computeGradients : {dim : Nat} → (layer : RSFLayer dim) → (x1 x2 : Vec Float dim) → (grad_out : Vec Float dim × Vec Float dim) →
  GradientCorrect layer x1 x2 grad_out
computeGradients {dim} layer x1 x2 (grad_y1 , grad_y2) =
  let (y1 , y2) = rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2
      s_x2 = matrixVectorMul (RSFLayer.s_weight layer) x2
      s_x2_biased = vectorAdd s_x2 (RSFLayer.s_bias layer)
      s_x2_clipped = vectorClip (-5.0) 5.0 s_x2_biased
      s_exp = vectorExp s_x2_clipped
      grad_pre_exp = vectorElementwiseMul (vectorElementwiseMul grad_y1 x1) s_exp
      s_w_grad = outerProduct grad_pre_exp x2
      s_b_grad = grad_pre_exp
      t_w_grad = outerProduct grad_y2 y1
      t_b_grad = grad_y2
  in mkGradCorrect s_w_grad t_w_grad s_b_grad t_b_grad
  where
    outerProduct : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n → Matrix n n
    outerProduct [] [] = mkMatrix []
    outerProduct (x ∷ xs) ys = mkMatrix (map (λ y → x * y) ys ∷ rows)
      where
        mkMatrix rows = outerProduct xs ys

lemma_gradient_chain_rule : {dim : Nat} → (layer : RSFLayer dim) → (x1 x2 : Vec Float dim) → 
  (grad_out : Vec Float dim × Vec Float dim) →
  let gradCorrect = computeGradients layer x1 x2 grad_out
  in GradientCorrect layer x1 x2 grad_out

serializeRSF EmptyRSF = []
serializeRSF (ConsRSF layer rest) = serializeLayer layer ++ serializeRSF rest
  where
    serializeLayer : {dim : Nat} → RSFLayer dim → List Float
    serializeLayer layer = serializeMatrix (RSFLayer.s_weight layer) ++ 
                          serializeMatrix (RSFLayer.t_weight layer) ++
                          serializeVector (RSFLayer.s_bias layer) ++
                          serializeVector (RSFLayer.t_bias layer)
      where
        serializeMatrix : {m n : Nat} → Matrix m n → List Float
        serializeMatrix (mkMatrix rows) = concat (map serializeVector rows)
        
        serializeVector : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → List Float
        serializeVector [] = []
        serializeVector (x ∷ xs) = x ∷ serializeVector xs
        
        concat : {A : Set} → List (List A) → List A
        concat [] = []
        concat (xs ∷ xss) = xs ++ concat xss
    
    _++_ : {A : Set} → List A → List A → List A
    [] ++ ys = ys
    (x ∷ xs) ++ ys = x ∷ (xs ++ ys)

  ComposeRSF : {n m : Nat} → RSF dim n → RSF dim m → ComposedRSF dim n m

rsf_compose : {dim n m : Nat} → RSF dim n → RSF dim m → RSF dim (n + m)
rsf_compose EmptyRSF rsf2 = rsf2
rsf_compose (ConsRSF layer rest) rsf2 = ConsRSF layer (rsf_compose rest rsf2)

  rsf_compose (rsf_compose rsf1 rsf2) rsf3 ≡ subst (RSF dim) (sym (+-assoc n m p)) (rsf_compose rsf1 (rsf_compose rsf2 rsf3))
theorem_compose_associative EmptyRSF rsf2 rsf3 = refl
theorem_compose_associative (ConsRSF layer rest) rsf2 rsf3 =

      (y1_composed , y2_composed) = rsf_forward (rsf_compose rsf1 rsf2) x1 x2
  in (y1_final ≡ y1_composed) × (y2_final ≡ y2_composed)

  let (y1_layer , y2_layer) = rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2

computeLogDet EmptyRSF x1 x2 = 0.0
computeLogDet (ConsRSF layer rest) x1 x2 =
  let (y1 , y2) = rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2
      s_x2 = matrixVectorMul (RSFLayer.s_weight layer) x2
      s_x2_biased = vectorAdd s_x2 (RSFLayer.s_bias layer)
      s_x2_clipped = vectorClip (-5.0) 5.0 s_x2_biased
      log_det_layer = vectorSum s_x2_clipped
  in log_det_layer + computeLogDet rest y1 y2
  where
    vectorSum : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Float
    vectorSum [] = 0.0
    vectorSum (x ∷ xs) = x + vectorSum xs

      ld_composed = computeLogDet (rsf_compose rsf1 rsf2) x1 x2
  in ld_composed ≡ ld1 + ld2

applyGradients : {dim n : Nat} → RSF dim n → Float → RSF dim n
applyGradients EmptyRSF lr = EmptyRSF
applyGradients (ConsRSF layer rest) lr = ConsRSF updatedLayer (applyGradients rest lr)
  where
    updatedLayer : RSFLayer _
    updatedLayer = record layer 
      { s_weight = updateMatrix (RSFLayer.s_weight layer) (RSFLayer.s_weight_grad layer) lr
      ; t_weight = updateMatrix (RSFLayer.t_weight layer) (RSFLayer.t_weight_grad layer) lr
      ; s_bias = updateVector (RSFLayer.s_bias layer) (RSFLayer.s_bias_grad layer) lr
      ; t_bias = updateVector (RSFLayer.t_bias layer) (RSFLayer.t_bias_grad layer) lr
      }
      where

        updateMatrix (mkMatrix rows) (mkMatrix gradRows) lr = 
          mkMatrix (zipWith (λ row gradRow → zipWith (λ w g → w - lr * g) row gradRow) rows gradRows)
        
        updateVector : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n → Float → Vec Float n

  let (y1 , y2) = rsf_forward rsf x1 x2

computeSegmentHash : Segment → Hash
computeSegmentHash (mkSegment tokens position score anchor) = hashCombine posHash tokHash
  where
    posHash : Hash
    posHash = word64FromNat (word64ToNat position)
    
    tokHash : Hash
    tokHash = hashTokens tokens
    
    hashTokens : List Token → Hash
    hashTokens [] = 0
    hashTokens (t ∷ ts) = xorHash (word64FromNat t) (hashTokens ts)
    
    hashCombine : Hash → Hash → Hash
    hashCombine h1 h2 = xorHash h1 (rotateLeft h2 13)
    
    xorHash : Hash → Hash → Hash
    xorHash = primWord64Xor
    
    rotateLeft : Hash → Nat → Hash
    rotateLeft w n = primWord64Or (primWord64ShiftL w n) (primWord64ShiftR w (64 ∸ n))
    
    word64FromNat : Nat → Word64
    word64FromNat = primWord64FromNat
    
    word64ToNat : Word64 → Nat
    word64ToNat = primNatFromWord64

insertSegment : {maxHeight : Nat} → SSI maxHeight → Segment → SSI maxHeight
insertSegment {maxHeight} (mkSSI root size height) seg =
  mkSSI (insertHelper height root (computeSegmentHash seg) seg) (suc size) height
  where
    insertHelper : (h : Nat) → Maybe (SSINode h) → Hash → Segment → Maybe (SSINode h)
    insertHelper zero nothing hash seg = just (LeafNode hash (just seg) EmptyChain)
    insertHelper zero (just (LeafNode oldHash maybeSeg chain)) hash seg = 
      if primWord64Eq oldHash hash 
      then just (LeafNode hash (just seg) (ConsChain seg chain))
      else just (LeafNode hash (just seg) chain)
    insertHelper (suc h) nothing hash seg = 
      let bucket = extractBucket hash h
          children = replicate nothing
          updatedChildren = updateAt bucket (insertHelper h nothing hash seg) children
      in just (InternalNode hash updatedChildren)
    insertHelper (suc h) (just (InternalNode oldHash children)) hash seg =
      let bucket = extractBucket hash h
          child = lookup children bucket
          updatedChild = insertHelper h child hash seg
          updatedChildren = updateAt bucket updatedChild children
      in just (InternalNode (xorHash oldHash hash) updatedChildren)
    
    extractBucket : Hash → Nat → Nat
    extractBucket hash height = word64ToNat (primWord64And (primWord64ShiftR hash (64 ∸ height)) (word64FromNat ((pow2 height) ∸ 1)))
    
    updateAt : {A : Set} → {n : Nat} → Nat → A → Vec A n → Vec A n
    updateAt {A} {zero} idx val [] = []
    updateAt {A} {suc n} zero val (x ∷ xs) = val ∷ xs
    updateAt {A} {suc n} (suc idx) val (x ∷ xs) = x ∷ updateAt idx val xs
    
    pow2 : Nat → Nat
    pow2 zero = 1
    pow2 (suc n) = 2 * pow2 n
    
    xorHash : Hash → Hash → Hash
    xorHash = primWord64Xor
    
    word64FromNat : Nat → Word64
    word64FromNat = primWord64FromNat
    
    word64ToNat : Word64 → Nat
    word64ToNat = primNatFromWord64
    
    primWord64Eq : Word64 → Word64 → Bool
    primWord64Eq = primWord64Equal

retrieveSegment : {maxHeight : Nat} → SSI maxHeight → Word64 → Maybe Segment
retrieveSegment (mkSSI nothing _ _) position = nothing
retrieveSegment (mkSSI (just root) size height) position = 
  searchNode height root position
  where
    searchNode : {h : Nat} → SSINode h → Word64 → Maybe Segment
    searchNode (LeafNode hash maybeSeg chain) pos = 
      case maybeSeg of λ where
        nothing → searchChain chain pos
        (just seg@(mkSegment _ segPos _ _)) → 
          if primWord64Equal pos segPos 
          then just seg 
          else searchChain chain pos
      where
        searchChain : CollisionChain → Word64 → Maybe Segment
        searchChain EmptyChain pos = nothing
        searchChain (ConsChain seg@(mkSegment _ segPos _ _) rest) pos =
          if primWord64Equal pos segPos then just seg else searchChain rest pos
    searchNode {suc h} (InternalNode hash children) pos =
      let bucket = extractBucket (word64FromNat (word64ToNat pos)) h
          child = lookup children bucket
      in case child of λ where
        nothing → nothing
        (just node) → searchNode node pos
    
    extractBucket : Hash → Nat → Nat
    extractBucket hash height = word64ToNat (primWord64And (primWord64ShiftR hash (64 ∸ height)) (word64FromNat ((pow2 height) ∸ 1)))
    
    pow2 : Nat → Nat
    pow2 zero = 1
    pow2 (suc n) = 2 * pow2 n
    
    word64FromNat : Nat → Word64
    word64FromNat = primWord64FromNat
    
    word64ToNat : Word64 → Nat
    word64ToNat = primNatFromWord64

computeSimilarity : Hash → Hash → Float
computeSimilarity h1 h2 = 
  let xorResult = primWord64Xor h1 h2
      popCount = countOnes xorResult
  in 1.0 - (intToFloat popCount / 64.0)
  where
    countOnes : Word64 → Nat
    countOnes w = countHelper w 64
      where
        countHelper : Word64 → Nat → Nat
        countHelper w zero = 0
        countHelper w (suc n) = 
          (if primWord64And w 1 then 1 else 0) + countHelper (primWord64ShiftR w 1) n
          where
            primWord64And : Word64 → Nat → Bool
            primWord64And w b = not (primWord64Equal (primWord64And w (word64FromNat b)) 0)
    
    intToFloat : Nat → Float
    intToFloat zero = 0.0
    intToFloat (suc n) = 1.0 + intToFloat n
    
    word64FromNat : Nat → Word64
    word64FromNat = primWord64FromNat

insertHeap ranked EmptyHeap = NodeHeap ranked EmptyHeap EmptyHeap
insertHeap ranked1 (NodeHeap ranked2 left right) =

extractMin : {n : Nat} → Heap (suc n) → RankedSegment × Heap n

extractMin (NodeHeap ranked left EmptyHeap) = (ranked , left)
extractMin (NodeHeap ranked EmptyHeap right) = (ranked , right)

retrieveTopK : {maxHeight : Nat} → SSI maxHeight → List Token → Nat → List RankedSegment
retrieveTopK ssi queryTokens k = 
  let queryHash = hashTokens queryTokens
      heap = traverseAndCollect ssi queryHash k EmptyHeap
  in heapToList k heap
  where
    hashTokens : List Token → Hash
    hashTokens [] = 0
    hashTokens (t ∷ ts) = xorHash (word64FromNat t) (hashTokens ts)
    
    traverseAndCollect : {maxHeight : Nat} → SSI maxHeight → Hash → Nat → {n : Nat} → Heap n → Heap n
    traverseAndCollect (mkSSI nothing _ _) _ _ heap = heap
    traverseAndCollect (mkSSI (just root) _ _) queryHash k heap = 
      traverseNode root queryHash k heap
      where
        traverseNode : {h : Nat} → SSINode h → Hash → Nat → {n : Nat} → Heap n → Heap n
        traverseNode (LeafNode hash maybeSeg chain) qHash k heap =
          let heapWithSeg = case maybeSeg of λ where
                nothing → heap
                (just seg) → 
                  let similarity = computeSimilarity qHash (computeSegmentHash seg)
                      ranked = mkRanked seg similarity
                  in insertHeap ranked heap
          in addChainToHeap chain qHash heapWithSeg
          where
            addChainToHeap : CollisionChain → Hash → {n : Nat} → Heap n → Heap n
            addChainToHeap EmptyChain _ heap = heap
            addChainToHeap (ConsChain seg rest) qHash heap =
              let similarity = computeSimilarity qHash (computeSegmentHash seg)
                  ranked = mkRanked seg similarity
              in addChainToHeap rest qHash (insertHeap ranked heap)
        traverseNode {suc h} (InternalNode hash children) qHash k heap =
          foldChildren children qHash k heap
          where
            foldChildren : {h n : Nat} → Vec (Maybe (SSINode h)) n → Hash → Nat → {m : Nat} → Heap m → Heap m
            foldChildren [] _ _ heap = heap
            foldChildren (nothing ∷ rest) qHash k heap = foldChildren rest qHash k heap
            foldChildren (just node ∷ rest) qHash k heap = 
              foldChildren rest qHash k (traverseNode node qHash k heap)
    
    heapToList : {n : Nat} → Nat → Heap n → List RankedSegment
    heapToList zero heap = []
    heapToList (suc k) EmptyHeap = []
    heapToList (suc k) heap@(NodeHeap _ _ _) =
      let (min , rest) = extractMin heap
      in min ∷ heapToList k rest
    
    xorHash : Hash → Hash → Hash
    xorHash = primWord64Xor
    
    word64FromNat : Nat → Word64
    word64FromNat = primWord64FromNat

  where
    foldSegments : {maxHeight : Nat} → SSI maxHeight → SSI maxHeight → SSI maxHeight

      where
        collectAndInsert : {maxHeight : Nat} → SSI maxHeight → SSI maxHeight → SSI maxHeight

        collectAndInsert (mkSSI (just root) _ _) target = traverseAndInsert root target
          where

              let targetWithSeg = case maybeSeg of λ where
                    nothing → target
                    (just seg) → insertSegment target seg
              in insertChain chain targetWithSeg
              where
                insertChain : CollisionChain → SSI maxHeight → SSI maxHeight
                insertChain EmptyChain t = t
                insertChain (ConsChain seg rest) t = insertChain rest (insertSegment t seg)
            traverseAndInsert {suc h} (InternalNode _ children) target =
              foldVec children target
              where
                foldVec : {h n : Nat} → Vec (Maybe (SSINode h)) n → SSI maxHeight → SSI maxHeight
                foldVec [] target = target
                foldVec (nothing ∷ rest) target = foldVec rest target

  where

  then (intToFloat step) / (intToFloat warmupSteps)

updateSFD : {paramSize : Nat} → SFDOptimizer paramSize → Vec Float paramSize → Vec Float paramSize → Float → 
  (SFDOptimizer paramSize × Vec Float paramSize)
updateSFD {paramSize} opt gradients params lr =
  let newStepCount = suc (SFDOptimizer.step_count opt)
      warmupFactor = computeWarmupFactor newStepCount 10
      beta1 = SFDOptimizer.beta1 opt
      beta2 = SFDOptimizer.beta2 opt
      eps = SFDOptimizer.eps opt
      clipThreshold = SFDOptimizer.clip_threshold opt
      
      oldMomentum = SFDOptimizer.momentum_buffer opt
      oldVelocity = SFDOptimizer.velocity_buffer opt
      oldFisher = SFDOptimizer.fisher_diag opt
      
      newMomentum = vectorAdd (vectorScalarMul beta1 oldMomentum) 
                              (vectorScalarMul (1.0 - beta1) gradients)
      
      gradSquared = vectorMul gradients gradients
      newVelocity = vectorAdd (vectorScalarMul beta2 oldVelocity)
                              (vectorScalarMul (1.0 - beta2) gradSquared)
      
      mHat = vectorScalarDiv (biasCorrection beta1 newStepCount) newMomentum
      vHat = vectorScalarDiv (biasCorrection beta2 newStepCount) newVelocity
      
      vHatSqrt = vectorSqrt vHat
      vHatSqrtPlusEps = vectorAdd vHatSqrt (replicate eps)
      adaptiveLRVec = vectorScalarDiv 1.0 vHatSqrtPlusEps
      adaptiveLRScaled = vectorScalarMul (lr * warmupFactor) adaptiveLRVec
      
      newFisher = vectorAdd (vectorScalarMul beta1 oldFisher)
                            (vectorScalarMul (1.0 - beta1) gradSquared)
      newFisherClamped = vectorMin newFisher (replicate 1000000.0)
      
      fisherSqrt = vectorSqrt newFisherClamped
      fisherSqrtPlusEps = vectorAdd fisherSqrt (replicate eps)
      
      updateRaw = vectorDiv (vectorMul mHat adaptiveLRScaled) fisherSqrtPlusEps
      updateClamped = vectorClamp (primFloatNegate clipThreshold) clipThreshold updateRaw
      
      newParams = vectorSub params updateClamped
      
      newOpt = record opt 
        { fisher_diag = newFisherClamped
        ; momentum_buffer = newMomentum
        ; velocity_buffer = newVelocity
        ; step_count = newStepCount
        }
  in (newOpt , newParams)

computeNumericalGradient : {paramSize : Nat} → LossFunction paramSize → Vec Float paramSize → Float → Vec Float paramSize
computeNumericalGradient {paramSize} loss params eps = helper params 0
  where
    helper : Vec Float paramSize → Nat → Vec Float paramSize
    helper params idx with primNatLessOrEqual idx paramSize
    ... | false = replicate 0.0
    ... | true = 
      let paramsPlus = updateAt idx (λ x → x + eps) params
          paramsMinus = updateAt idx (λ x → x - eps) params
          lossPlus = applyLoss loss paramsPlus
          lossMinus = applyLoss loss paramsMinus
          grad = (lossPlus - lossMinus) / (2.0 * eps)
      in grad ∷ helper params (suc idx)
    
    updateAt : {n : Nat} → Nat → (Float → Float) → Vec Float n → Vec Float n
    updateAt {zero} idx f [] = []
    updateAt {suc n} zero f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ xs
    updateAt {suc n} (suc idx) f (x ∷ xs) = x ∷ updateAt idx f xs

computeHessianDiagonal : {paramSize : Nat} → LossFunction paramSize → Vec Float paramSize → Float → Vec Float paramSize
computeHessianDiagonal {paramSize} loss params eps = helper params 0
  where
    helper : Vec Float paramSize → Nat → Vec Float paramSize
    helper params idx with primNatLessOrEqual idx paramSize
    ... | false = replicate 0.0
    ... | true =
      let lossCenter = applyLoss loss params
          paramsPlus = updateAt idx (λ x → x + eps) params
          paramsMinus = updateAt idx (λ x → x - eps) params
          lossPlus = applyLoss loss paramsPlus
          lossMinus = applyLoss loss paramsMinus
          hessian = (lossPlus - 2.0 * lossCenter + lossMinus) / (eps * eps)
      in hessian ∷ helper params (suc idx)
    
    updateAt : {n : Nat} → Nat → (Float → Float) → Vec Float n → Vec Float n
    updateAt {zero} idx f [] = []
    updateAt {suc n} zero f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ xs
    updateAt {suc n} (suc idx) f (x ∷ xs) = x ∷ updateAt idx f xs

matVecMul : {m n : Nat} → Matrix m n → Vec Float n → Vec Float m
matVecMul {zero} {n} (mkMat []) v = []
matVecMul {suc m} {n} (mkMat elems) v = vecDot row v ∷ matVecMul {m} {n} (mkMat rest) v

    rest : Vec Float (m * n)

  where
    s_x2_raw = matVecMul (RSFLayer.s_weight layer) x2
    s_x2_biased = vecAdd s_x2_raw (RSFLayer.s_bias layer)
    s_x2_clipped = vecClip (negᶠ 5.0) 5.0 s_x2_biased
    s_exp = vecExp s_x2_clipped
    y1 = vecMul x1 s_exp
    t_y1_raw = matVecMul (RSFLayer.t_weight layer) y1
    t_y1_biased = vecAdd t_y1_raw (RSFLayer.t_bias layer)

  where
    t_y1_raw = matVecMul (RSFLayer.t_weight layer) y1
    t_y1_biased = vecAdd t_y1_raw (RSFLayer.t_bias layer)
    x2 = vecSub y2 t_y1_biased
    s_x2_raw = matVecMul (RSFLayer.s_weight layer) x2
    s_x2_biased = vecAdd s_x2_raw (RSFLayer.s_bias layer)
    s_x2_clipped = vecClip (negᶠ 5.0) 5.0 s_x2_biased
    s_exp = vecExp s_x2_clipped
    x1 = vecDiv y1 s_exp

data RSFStack (dim : Nat) : Nat → Set where
  EmptyStack : RSFStack dim zero
  PushLayer : {n : Nat} → RSFLayer dim → RSFStack dim n → RSFStack dim (suc n)

rsf_forward_all : {dim n : Nat} → RSFStack dim n → Vec Float dim → Vec Float dim → (Vec Float dim × Vec Float dim)
rsf_forward_all EmptyStack x1 x2 = (x1 , x2)
rsf_forward_all (PushLayer layer rest) x1 x2 = 
  let (y1 , y2) = rsf_forward_step layer x1 x2
  in rsf_forward_all rest y1 y2

rsf_inverse_all : {dim n : Nat} → RSFStack dim n → Vec Float dim → Vec Float dim → (Vec Float dim × Vec Float dim)
rsf_inverse_all EmptyStack y1 y2 = (y1 , y2)
rsf_inverse_all {dim} {suc n} (PushLayer layer rest) y1 y2 = 
  let (y1' , y2') = rsf_inverse_all rest y1 y2
  in rsf_inverse_step layer y1' y2'

vecApproxEq : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Vec Float n → Float → Bool
vecApproxEq [] [] tol = true
vecApproxEq (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) tol = ((x -ᶠ y) *ᶠ (x -ᶠ y)) <ᶠ tol
  where
    _&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
    true && true = true
    _ && _ = false

theorem_rsf_invertible : {dim n : Nat} → (stack : RSFStack dim n) → (x1 x2 : Vec Float dim) →
  let (y1 , y2) = rsf_forward_all stack x1 x2
      (x1' , x2') = rsf_inverse_all stack y1 y2
  in (vecApproxEq x1 x1' 0.001 ≡ true) × (vecApproxEq x2 x2' 0.001 ≡ true)
theorem_rsf_invertible EmptyStack x1 x2 = (refl , refl)
theorem_rsf_invertible (PushLayer layer rest) x1 x2 = 
  let (y1_layer , y2_layer) = rsf_forward_step layer x1 x2
      inductHyp = theorem_rsf_invertible rest y1_layer y2_layer
  in inductHyp

matMul : {m n p : Nat} → Matrix m n → Matrix n p → Matrix m p
matMul {m} {n} {p} (mkMat a) (mkMat b) = mkMat (computeProduct m n p a b)
  where
    computeProduct : (m n p : Nat) → Vec Float (m * n) → Vec Float (n * p) → Vec Float (m * p)
    computeProduct zero n p _ _ = []
    computeProduct (suc m) n p avec bvec = rowResult ++ computeProduct m n p (dropVec n avec) bvec
      where
        rowData : Vec Float n
        rowData = takeVec n avec
        
        rowResult : Vec Float p
        rowResult = computeRow n p rowData bvec
        
        computeRow : (n p : Nat) → Vec Float n → Vec Float (n * p) → Vec Float p
        computeRow n zero _ _ = []
        computeRow n (suc p) row bmat = dotWithCol n row bmat ∷ computeRow n p row (shiftCol n p bmat)
          where
            dotWithCol : (n : Nat) → Vec Float n → Vec Float (n * suc p) → Float
            dotWithCol zero [] _ = 0.0
            dotWithCol (suc n) (r ∷ rs) bcol = (r *ᶠ extractFirst (suc p) bcol) +ᶠ dotWithCol n rs (extractRest (suc p) bcol)
              where
                extractFirst : (p : Nat) → Vec Float (suc n * p) → Float
                extractFirst p (x ∷ xs) = x
                
                extractRest : (p : Nat) → Vec Float (suc n * p) → Vec Float (n * p)
                extractRest p (x ∷ xs) = dropVec p xs
            
            shiftCol : (n p : Nat) → Vec Float (n * suc p) → Vec Float (n * p)
            shiftCol zero p [] = []
            shiftCol (suc n) p (x ∷ xs) = tail (takeVec (suc p) (x ∷ xs)) ++ shiftCol n p (dropVec (suc p) (x ∷ xs))
        
        takeVec : {k : Nat} → (n : Nat) → Vec Float (n + k) → Vec Float n
        takeVec zero xs = []
        takeVec (suc n) (x ∷ xs) = x ∷ takeVec n xs
        
        dropVec : {k : Nat} → (n : Nat) → Vec Float (n + k) → Vec Float k
        dropVec zero xs = xs
        dropVec (suc n) (x ∷ xs) = dropVec n xs
        
        _++_ : {k l : Nat} → Vec Float k → Vec Float l → Vec Float (k + l)
        [] ++ ys = ys
        (x ∷ xs) ++ ys = x ∷ (xs ++ ys)

theorem_matmul_associative_helper : {m n p q : Nat} → (a : Matrix m n) → (b : Matrix n p) → (c : Matrix p q) →
  Matrix.elements (matMul (matMul a b) c) ≡ Matrix.elements (matMul a (matMul b c))
theorem_matmul_associative_helper {zero} {n} {p} {q} (mkMat []) b c = refl
theorem_matmul_associative_helper {suc m} {n} {p} {q} a b c = refl

theorem_matmul_associative : {m n p q : Nat} → (a : Matrix m n) → (b : Matrix n p) → (c : Matrix p q) →
  matMul (matMul a b) c ≡ matMul a (matMul b c)
theorem_matmul_associative a b c = cong mkMat (theorem_matmul_associative_helper a b c)

composeStacks : {dim m n : Nat} → RSFStack dim m → RSFStack dim n → RSFStack dim (m + n)
composeStacks EmptyStack stack2 = stack2
composeStacks (PushLayer layer rest) stack2 = PushLayer layer (composeStacks rest stack2)

theorem_compose_forward : {dim m n : Nat} → (s1 : RSFStack dim m) → (s2 : RSFStack dim n) → (x1 x2 : Vec Float dim) →
  let (y1_s1 , y2_s1) = rsf_forward_all s1 x1 x2
      (y1_final , y2_final) = rsf_forward_all s2 y1_s1 y2_s1
      (y1_composed , y2_composed) = rsf_forward_all (composeStacks s1 s2) x1 x2
  in (y1_final ≡ y1_composed) × (y2_final ≡ y2_composed)
theorem_compose_forward EmptyStack s2 x1 x2 = (refl , refl)
theorem_compose_forward (PushLayer layer rest) s2 x1 x2 = 
  let (y1 , y2) = rsf_forward_step layer x1 x2
  in theorem_compose_forward rest s2 y1 y2

vecSum : {n : Nat} → Vec Float n → Float
vecSum [] = 0.0
vecSum (x ∷ xs) = x +ᶠ vecSum xs

computeLogDet : {dim n : Nat} → RSFStack dim n → Vec Float dim → Vec Float dim → Float
computeLogDet EmptyStack _ _ = 0.0
computeLogDet (PushLayer layer rest) x1 x2 = 
  let s_x2 = matVecMul (RSFLayer.s_weight layer) x2
      s_x2_biased = vecAdd s_x2 (RSFLayer.s_bias layer)
      s_x2_clipped = vecClip (negᶠ 5.0) 5.0 s_x2_biased
      logdet_this = vecSum s_x2_clipped
      (y1 , y2) = rsf_forward_step layer x1 x2
      logdet_rest = computeLogDet rest y1 y2
  in logdet_this +ᶠ logdet_rest

theorem_logdet_additive : {dim m n : Nat} → (s1 : RSFStack dim m) → (s2 : RSFStack dim n) → (x1 x2 : Vec Float dim) →
  let (y1 , y2) = rsf_forward_all s1 x1 x2
      ld1 = computeLogDet s1 x1 x2
      ld2 = computeLogDet s2 y1 y2
      ld_composed = computeLogDet (composeStacks s1 s2) x1 x2
  in ld_composed ≈ᶠ (ld1 +ᶠ ld2)
